author: Praxis I
title: PBAGC-BalancedGraph-cosine-45-noalign-resid0.75: PCA + Batch Residualization + Balanced kNN
abstract: Fine-tune residualization to gamma=0.75 (l2=1e-3) on PCA and build a cosine, equal-quotas, 45-neighbor balanced kNN graph. Goal: refine around the 0.74 peak to see if score nudges higher.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/praxis')

import numpy as np
import scanpy as sc
import anndata as ad
from scipy import sparse as sp

from pbagc import _normalize_log1p_inplace, _get_hvg_mask, _pca_truncated_svd
from balanced_graph import build_balanced_knn
from residualize import residualize_pcs_against_batch

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    n_pca_components = 50
    n_neighbors_total = 45
    metric = 'cosine'
    l2 = 1e-3
    gamma = 0.75

    print(f"[Config] PCs={n_pca_components}, neighbors={n_neighbors_total}, metric={metric}, residualize(gamma={gamma}, l2={l2})")

    assert 'batch' in adata.obs.columns and 'feature_name' in adata.var.columns

    _normalize_log1p_inplace(adata, target_sum=1e4)
    hvg_mask = _get_hvg_mask(adata)
    if hvg_mask.sum() < 10: hvg_mask = np.ones(adata.n_vars, dtype=bool)

    X = adata.X[:, hvg_mask]
    if not sp.issparse(X): X = sp.csr_matrix(X)
    Z = _pca_truncated_svd(X, n_comps=n_pca_components, random_state=0)

    batches = np.asarray(adata.obs['batch'].astype('category').values)
    Z_resid = residualize_pcs_against_batch(Z, batches, l2=l2, gamma=gamma, center=True)

    adata.obsm['X_emb'] = Z_resid
    sc.pp.neighbors(adata, use_rep='X_emb', n_neighbors=n_neighbors_total, method='umap', metric=metric)

    C, D = build_balanced_knn(
        Z_resid, batches, n_neighbors_total=n_neighbors_total,
        metric=metric, weighting='binary', allocation='equal', mutual=False, symmetric=True
    )
    if C is not None and D is not None:
        adata.obsp['connectivities'] = C.tocsr()
        adata.obsp['distances'] = D.tocsr()
    return adata
